study.title: A generative model for inorganic materials design
study.workflow_type: Single-pass property-conditioned diffusion generation with machine-learning-potential and DFT screening and experimental synthesis
study.assessment_scope: Completed from the article and its Supplementary Information only. The record covers the bulk-modulus synthesis campaign.

items.entry: Generation conditioned on a target bulk modulus produces a candidate that can be synthesised and whose measured bulk modulus lies within 20% of the 200 GPa target. Evidence level: experiment, with one target phase obtained from four synthesis attempts. Comparisons elsewhere in the study concern the rate of stable, unique, and novel structures relative to CDVAE and DiffCSP, and performance relative to substitution and random structure search in selected chemical systems.
source_locations: Zeni et al., Nature 639, 624-632 (2025), Experimental validation and Figs. 2-3 and 6

items.entry: Training set Alex-MP-20: 607,683 structures with at most 20 atoms and energy above hull below 0.1 eV/atom from the Materials Project (v2022.10.28) and Alexandria, both CC BY 4.0, recomputed with Materials Project settings and deduplicated with emmet; well-explored chemical systems and ICSD-only structures excluded. Reference set Alex-MP-ICSD (850,384 structures), extended with 117,652 disordered ICSD structures for novelty. Fine-tuning on approximately 5,000 DFT bulk-modulus labels. Matching rule: ordered-disordered structure matcher, compared with the pymatgen StructureMatcher (ltol 0.2, stol 0.3, angle_tol 5).

Training and validation sets are split independently and identically; experimental ICSD structures absent from the Materials Project at the cut-off date form a temporal test set of 4,387 structures, and a further 1,739 ICSD structures fall in the validation split.
Diffusion over atom types, fractional coordinates, and lattice with a GemNet score network; property conditioning by fine-tuning with adapter modules and classifier-free guidance.

Base model: 1.74 million steps, batch size 64 per GPU on eight A100 GPUs, Adam, initial learning rate 1e-4 with ReduceLROnPlateau (factor 0.6, patience 100). Fine-tuning: global batch size 128, initial learning rate 6e-5, gradient clipping at 0.5, stopped after 100 epochs without improvement in validation loss.

Targets of 50, 100, 150, and 200 GPa with 8,192 samples each; 1,000 reverse-diffusion steps with one Langevin corrector step per predictor step; an element mask excluding 27 elements for toxicity, price, availability, or handling.

Success in this campaign: a target phase obtained by synthesis, with a measured bulk modulus within 20% of the target. The obtained phase has a DFT bulk modulus of 222 GPa for its ordered structure; nanoindentation gives 158 ± 11 GPa over four measurements, up to 169 GPa. Novelty: absence from Alex-MP-ICSD under the ordered-disordered matcher, with the sensitivity of uniqueness and novelty to the choice of matcher reported. The novelty of the obtained phase has since been disputed (Juelsholt, Materials Horizons 13, 5672-5679, 2026).
source_locations: Zeni et al., Nature 639, 624-632 (2025), Experimental validation

items.entry: Composition: oxygen-containing candidates only. Thermodynamic stability: MatterSim energy above hull <= 0.05 eV/atom, then DFT <= 0.03 eV/atom with PBE, Hubbard U corrections, and Materials Project settings. Dynamical stability: MatterSim phonons with phonopy, supercells of about 300 atoms, 0.03 Å displacements; structures with negative modes removed. Synthesizability: expert selection by number of elements, precursor availability, and predicted local coordination; solid-state synthesis with X-ray diffraction and Rietveld refinement; three unsuccessful attempts reported.

Generative baselines CDVAE and DiffCSP; substitution and random structure search in selected chemical systems, relaxed with MatterSim and advanced to a common budget of 100 DFT calculations per system; for property-targeted generation, a screening baseline that selects training structures by predicted bulk modulus at the same DFT budget; component-wise ablations. No baseline is reported for the synthesis campaign itself.

Source code, the Alex-MP training data, CIF files of the reported structures, and the nanoindentation and X-ray diffraction data are publicly available; ICSD identifiers are listed, with structures available under a commercial licence.
source_locations: Zeni et al., Nature 639, 624-632 (2025), Data availability and Code availability

items.entry: Stable inorganic oxides targeted for mechanical properties; no hazardous target, autonomous execution pathway, or access restriction.

32,768 structures generated at four bulk-modulus targets; 7,919 containing oxygen; 2,196 within the MatterSim hull threshold; 551 unique and novel; 119 without imaginary phonon modes and evaluated with DFT; 75 within the DFT hull threshold; four synthesis attempts; one target phase obtained, with a measured bulk modulus within 20% of the target.
